Thakral One

Worked with Process Experts / Process Excellence Team, IT Advisors and Product owners for streamlined delivery Requirements.
16+ years of experience in Banking and Financial Services with strong expertise in Payments, Cards, SWIFT, ISO 20022, ISO 8583, NEFT, RTGS, Reconciliation, and payment message processing.
Well versed in designing solution & effort estimations. • Coordinate with change management & Release management teams. • Worked with Stakeholders in requirement gathering & supported Bas to convert them in to solution requirement i.e. BRD, FRD Contributed to the development of the Functional Specifications from a technical
Worked closely with Design Leads and Application Delivery Leads to ensure that new requirements are understood and applied in new work items.Strong understanding of ISO 20022 payment messaging standards and migration from legacy MT/IFTAS/SFMS messaging formats to MX/ISO 20022 standards across payment, trade finance, and cash management systems Hands-on experience in NEFT, RTGS, SWIFT MT103, MT202, MT199, MT191, MT192, and ISO 20022 messages such as pacs.008, pacs.009, pacs.002, camt.056, camt.029, and pain.001.
